title: ARCADE: IDLE RETURN AND END RUN
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 16 of 20. A party machine has to go back to the demo on its own when the players walk away. In the arcade each window now keeps track of when its player last touched anything. After 90 seconds with nobody playing it calls STILL PLAYING?, from 120 seconds it counts RUN ENDS IN 30 down, and at 150 seconds the run ends: the raid is torn down with nothing counted or saved, and the attract comes back with a RUN OVER card showing the team score and each player row. A player who walks off while the other keeps playing is benched instead: player 1 stands out under PLAYER 1: PRESS ANY BUTTON, and player 2 drops out to its own attract while the host hears PLAYER 2 OUT. The pause box in the arcade now offers END RUN in place of Settings and Abandon run. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade nobody playing for 150 seconds ends the run back to the demo with a RUN OVER card, a player who walks off is benched, and the pause box offers END RUN.
